主要内容: On February 12, 2016, the Compensation Committee of Medallion Financial Corp. approved fiscal year 2015 bonuses for key executives, including Alvin Murstein (CEO), Andrew Murstein (President), Larry Hall (CFO), Michael Kowalsky (Executive Vice President), and Donald Poulton (CEO and President of Medallion Bank). The bonuses ranged from $40,000 to $1,875,000, based on the company's overall performance in 2015. The Committee also approved salary increases for these executives, raising Alvin Murstein's base salary to $868,972, Andrew Murstein's to $1,017,040, Larry Hall's to $315,586, and Donald Poulton's to $263,550. Michael Kowalsky's base salary was increased to $339,553 effective July 1, 2016, as per his previously filed employment agreement dated August 3, 2006. These changes reflect the company's recognition of individual and company-wide performance during fiscal year 2015.
